name: CS2 (Source 2) Reverse Engineering & Modding API
usage_instructions_for_ai: Use signatures.json for verified IDA/Ghidra byte patterns and current RVAs/VAs across client.dll, server.dll, engine2.dll, networksystem.dll, schemasystem.dll, vphysics2.dll, animationsystem.dll, navsystem.dll, and pulse_system.dll. Use schemas.json for exact member byte offsets. Use sdk.json for clean-room C++17 headers and implementations.

self_update_protocol.summary: How AI agents and developers can obtain 100% up-to-date RVAs, signatures, and Schema offsets immediately after a CS2 Steam update, even if this GitHub repository has not been updated yet.

method_1_wildcard_pattern_scanning.when_to_use: Resolving shifted internal function RVAs/VAs (e.g. GetInaccuracy, FX_CalculateSpread, StartLagCompensation, AirAccelerate) on a newly patched CS2 binary.
method_1_wildcard_pattern_scanning.how_it_works: Every entry in /docs/api/v1/signatures.json contains an IDA/Ghidra wildcard byte pattern ('pattern') where '??' masks out relocatable 32-bit RIP-relative displacements. While 'current_rva' shifts by +N bytes after a game update, the 'pattern' remains invariant across builds.
method_1_wildcard_pattern_scanning.standalone_python_scanner:
import struct, re
def scan_pe_pattern(dll_path, ida_pattern):
    data = open(dll_path, 'rb').read()
    pe_off = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 0x3C)[0]
    num_sec = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 6)[0]
    opt_sz = struct.unpack_from('<H', data, pe_off + 20)[0]
    sec_table = pe_off + 24 + opt_sz
    regex = b''.join(b'.' if tok == '??' else re.escape(bytes.fromhex(tok)) for tok in ida_pattern.split())
    for i in range(num_sec):
        s = sec_table + i * 40
        vsize, rva, rsize, rptr = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', data, s + 8)
        m = re.search(regex, data[rptr:rptr+rsize], re.DOTALL)
        if m: return hex(rva + m.start()), hex(0x180000000 + rva + m.start())
    return None

method_2_runtime_schemasystem_reflection.when_to_use: Resolving class member offsets (C_CSPlayerPawn, CCSPlayerController, C_CSWeaponBase, CSkeletonInstance) without relying on static schemas.json offsets.
method_2_runtime_schemasystem_reflection.how_it_works: Query SchemaSystem_001 exported by schemasystem.dll -> CSchemaSystem::FindTypeScopeForModule('client.dll') (VTable slot 13) -> CSchemaSystemTypeScope::FindDeclaredClass('C_CSPlayerPawn') (VTable slot 2) -> iterate SchemaClassInfoData_t::m_pFields (+0x28) to read m_nSingleInheritanceOffset (+0x10). See game/schemasystem/schemasystem.h in sdk.json.
